description: This source file defines the internal class 'GatewayManager' which manages the list of known and dead gateways for Orleans clustering. It handles gateway discovery, refreshes, and connection management, including round-robin gateway selection, marking gateways as dead or unavailable, and periodically updating the gateway list from a provider.

classes.name: GatewayManager
classes.description: An internal class responsible for managing the list of gateway addresses, handling gateway refreshes, marking gateways as dead/unavailable, and selecting gateways for communication within the Orleans runtime.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Initializes the gateway list provider, retrieves gateway addresses, and starts periodic gateway refresh.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Stops the periodic gateway refresh timer and waits for any ongoing refresh tasks to complete.

methods.name: MarkAsDead
methods.description: Marks a specified gateway as dead, preventing future use.

methods.name: MarkAsUnavailableForSend
methods.description: Marks a specified gateway as temporarily unavailable for sending messages.

methods.name: GetLiveGateway
methods.description: Selects and returns a live gateway address using round-robin method.

methods.name: GetLiveGateways
methods.description: Returns the current cached list of live gateways, triggering a refresh if none are available.

methods.name: IsGatewayAvailable
methods.description: Checks whether a given gateway address is currently marked as available.

methods.name: ExpediteUpdateLiveGatewaysSnapshot
methods.description: Triggers an immediate refresh of the gateway list from the provider.

methods.name: PeriodicallyRefreshGatewaySnapshot
methods.description: Runs in a loop, periodically updating the gateway list based on a timer.

methods.name: RefreshGatewaySnapshot
methods.description: Fetches the latest gateway list from the provider and updates the internal state.

methods.name: UpdateLiveGatewaysSnapshot
methods.description: Updates the cached live gateways by removing dead/masked gateways based on recent health status.

methods.name: CloseEvictedGatewayConnections
methods.description: Closes connections to gateways that are no longer considered live.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes internal resources such as timers.
